correctness.rationale: All a,b>=2: explicit P fixes gradients; signed permutation averaging reduces both minima to a fully classified one-parameter family. Four exact column-norm formulas give two global lower bounds through triangle inequalities and aA+bB=1, both attained at rational interior parameters. Algebra proves optimizer separation and orthogonal thresholds. Exact rational 49-pair checker and four unrestricted small linear programs corroborate; infinite proof is analytical.
